battle.name: 護步達岡之戰
battle.brief: 金收國元年十二月，完顏阿骨打率二萬騎追擊遼天祚帝大軍於護步答岡，攻破遼軍中軍，遼軍大潰、屍橫百餘里，金軍取輿輦、幄帳、馬牛無數。戰場在今黑龍江五常以西的松花江中游，時值隆冬，交戰雙方只用冷兵器與騎兵；希臘火那時仍在拜占庭海軍服役，與東北亞的雪原追擊無關。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是兩個剛剛成形不久的國家體系。遼國是耶律氏建立的契丹帝國，五京分領北方與南面，軍政大權握在北面行樞密院手中，中京的南面官署只管漢地民政；帝國實行蕃漢兩制，契丹、奚、渤海、漢人各有兵籍與部族編制，兵源、裝備與指揮鏈並不統一，徵兵按戶丁計算，父死子繼、兄死弟及。天祚帝的御營由他直轄，諸路大軍則分交駙馬、林牙一類的貴族率領。金國是完顏氏聯合女真諸部於收國元年正月建立的政權，國號大金：軍政仍用女真舊俗，五大部族各領其眾，帶兵的猛安與軍師多出於各部首長與阿骨打的兄弟；同時在漢地另設南面官署，沿用遼的州縣與漢兵舊制。金軍主力是女真騎兵，徵發自松花江上中游的熟女真部落，並吸納了從遼境逃出的契丹叛人阿疏等人。
countriesEn: The two sides were two state systems, both of them young. Liao was the Khitan empire founded by the Yelü house: five capitals governed the northern and the southern circuits, and military power sat in the Northern Privy Council, while the southern offices in the Central Capital handled only civil administration for the Chinese-speaking districts. The empire ran on a dual system for barbarians and Han; Khitans, Xi, Bohai and Chinese each kept their own registers and tribal formations, so manpower, equipment and the chain of command were never uniform, and military service was counted by household, a dead father succeeded by his son and a dead elder brother by his younger one. The emperor's guard camp was under his own hand, and the separate armies went to princes consort and lanyas of the nobility. Jin was the state founded in the first month of the first year of Shouguo by the Wanyan house together with the other Jurchen tribes, taking the name Great Jin. Military affairs still followed Jurchen custom, the five great tribal groups each leading its own men, and the commanders who led them were drawn from the chiefs and from Aguda's own brothers; at the same time a separate southern administration governed the Chinese districts on the lines of Lao's prefectures and counties and the old Chinese levy. The core of the Jin army was Jurchen cavalry, levied among the settled Jurchen of the upper and middle Songhua, and it also drew in Khitan defectors who had fled Liao territory, among them A-shu.
people: 金國方面的核心是完顏阿骨打。這位完顏部的都勃極烈在收國元年正月稱帝之後，仍自將中軍。達魯古城一役後他主持軍議，採納大將軍宗雄強敵在前、如坐守防禦必被包圍的話，決定集中兵力主動出擊，而不是深溝高壘固守待敵；在熟結濼得知遼軍內亂的消息後，他先反問眾將，敵來不迎戰而去而追之，是否以此為勇，待眾將慚愧請戰才定下追擊；追到護步答岡，又斷定彼眾我寡、兵不可分，專攻遼之中軍而不分兵。完顏迪古乃、完顏銀術可奉命屯守達魯古城，鎖住後方；粘罕、兀術奉命出使遼廷，表面卑辭求和，實則覘探虛實。遼方的關鍵人物是天祚帝耶律延禧，他親率號稱七十萬的大軍到駝門，又遣駙馬蕭特末與林牙蕭察剌領五萬騎、四十萬步卒屯斡鄰濼，籌劃分進合擊；蕭特末等最終焚營遁去，天祚帝棄輿馬而走，一晝夜疾行五百里退回長春州。直接扭轉戰局的，還有遼將耶律張家奴在十二月乙巳日舉兵反遼，以及渤海國後裔古欲在饒州自稱王、牽制遼軍。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Jin side was Wanyan Aguda, the dubo qaghan of the Wanyan tribe, who after taking the imperial title in the first month of Shouguo still commanded the centre of his own army. Following the fighting at Dalucheng he presided over a council of war and took General Zongxiong's argument, that with a strong enemy in front a static camp would only get them surrounded, and resolved to concentrate his force and strike first instead of digging in behind deep trenches. When the news of the Liao mutiny reached him at Shujieluo he still asked his officers, in effect, whether running down an enemy who declined to fight was any proof of courage, and only when they had been put to shame and had clamoured to serve did he order the pursuit. At Hupudagang he judged that the enemy were many and he few, so he must not split his force, and he struck only at the Liao centre. Wanyan Digu'nai and Wanyan Yinshuke were sent to hold Dalucheng and cover the rear; Nikan and Wuzhu were sent as envoys to the Liao court, humbling themselves in words while in fact measuring the enemy's will to fight. On the Liao side the key figure was the emperor Tianzuo, Yelü Yanxi, who led an army proclaimed at seven hundred thousand men to Tuomen, and further dispatched his prince consort Xiao Temo and the lanya Xiao Chala with fifty thousand cavalry and four hundred thousand foot to hold Wolinluo, planning a converging attack. Xiao Temo and the others eventually burned their camp and escaped, and the emperor abandoned his chariot and horses and rode day and night for five hundred li back to Changchunzhou. What actually turned the battle was the revolt of the Liao commander Yelü Zhangjiano on the yisi day of the twelfth month, together with the self-proclaimed king Guyu of the descendants of the Bohai kingdom at Raozhou, who tied down Liao troops.
kits: 這件兵器是拜占庭帝國的燃燒劑，公元六七〇年前後由赫利奧波利斯的工匠卡利尼科斯改良配方而成：燃燒劑裝在銅管之中，由專門的火船與專門的射手操作，噴出時伴隨轟響與濃煙，落在水面仍能燃燒，對方只能以沙、醋或陳尿滅火。它是海軍武器，憑藉的是整套嚴格分權的體系——配方的調製、加熱加壓的爐具、銅管的射法、專司操作的射手彼此不通姓名，敵人即使繳獲銅管與殘料也無從複製。帝國先後在六二六年、七一七至七一八年的君士坦丁堡保衛戰、九四一年與一〇四三年的抗羅斯襲擊、九七〇至九七一年的對保加利亞戰爭中用過它，十二世紀仍有記載，一二〇三年第四次十字軍圍城時火船在金角灣被毀，配方從此失傳。可是護步答岡的雪原上沒有這種武器：交戰的雙方都還在火藥兵器出現之前三個多世紀，兵裝是角弓、長矛、大刀、札甲與皮甲，攻城只靠望樓、撞竿與壕壘，唯一的火是蕭特末焚營時自己點燃的營帳。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the incendiary of the Byzantine Empire, developed around 670 by an artificer from Heliopolis named Kallinikos: the burning mixture was carried in copper tubes, worked from purpose-built fireships and by trained operators, and when it was spat out it came with a roar and heavy smoke, burned on the surface of water, and could be smothered only with sand, vinegar or stale urine. It was a naval weapon, and it rested on an entire system of strictly compartmented knowledge: the compounding of the mixture, the heating and pressurising apparatus, the way the tube was worked and the men who served it each knew only their own part, so an enemy who captured tubes and residue could never copy the whole. The empire used it in the defence of Constantinople in 626 and again in 717 and 718, against the Rus raids of 941 and 1043, and in the war against Bulgaria in 970 and 971; it was still recorded in the twelfth century, and when the Fourth Crusade besieged Constantinople in 1203 the fireships were destroyed in the Golden Horn and the formula was lost for good. Nothing of the sort stood on the snowy plain of Hupudagang. Both sides were still more than three centuries short of gunpowder: their arms were composite bows, spears, sabres, lamellar and leather armour, sieges were carried on with towers, rams and ditches, and the only fire in the field was the camp that Xiao Temo set alight himself as he ran.
tactics: 金軍的做法有三層。第一層是分兵與野戰的配合：爻刺築壘、達魯古城留兵，主力二萬騎握在手裡，進退都有著落。第二層是作戰前的軍議制度——將領環坐，以灰在地上畫策，隨畫隨議，最後由最高指揮擇善而定，阿骨打據此採納了主動出擊。第三層是會戰本身的打法：遼軍以駝門與斡鄰濼兩路分進合擊，本是鉗形夾擊，但內訌加上冬季行軍距離太遠，合擊始終沒有合上；金軍則不與其糾纏，專攻遼之中軍——視其中軍最堅、遼主必在焉，先以右翼騎兵擊中軍，再合左翼兵力一齊壓上，遼軍中軍一破，全軍便失去骨幹。追擊的節奏同樣是戰術的一部分：遼軍退則焚營，天祚帝棄輿馬晝夜疾行五百里，金軍則以騎兵尾追不放，並在沿途取開州、特鄰城，迫令辭里罕等部眾投降。冬季的松花江中游是這樣的戰場：地面封凍可行騎，草甸可供馬群放牧，但也意味著人馬給養全靠隨軍備載與打草谷式的就地徵發。
tacticsEn: The Jin approach had three layers. The first was the pairing of detachment work with open battle: they dug in at Yaci, left a garrison at Dalucheng, and kept the main body of twenty thousand cavalry in their own hands, so that every advance had its anchor. The second was the council of war held before the action, in which the commanders sat in a ring, drew their plans in ash on the ground, argued as they drew, and left the highest commander to choose the best of them; Aguda's decision to attack in strength was taken in exactly this fashion. The third was the battle itself. The Liao planned a converging attack from Tuomen and Wolinluo, a pincer in principle, but mutiny and the long winter marches kept the two wings from ever closing; the Jin refused to be drawn into a general engagement and went straight for the Liao centre, on the reasoning that the Liao centre was the strongest part and the Liao ruler must be in it. The right wing first struck the Liao centre, then the left was brought in against it, and once the Liao centre gave way the whole Liao army lost its backbone. The rhythm of the pursuit was part of the tactic as well: the Liao burned their camp as they withdrew, the emperor abandoned his chariot and horses and covered five hundred li in a day and a night, while the Jin cavalry hung on the retreat without slackening, took Kai Prefecture and the city of Telin along the way, and pressed Cili Khan and the other tribal leaders into surrender. The winter middle course of the Songhua was a battlefield of this kind: frozen ground carried the horses and the meadows pastured the herds, and it also meant that men and animals could eat only from what the column carried and from foraging on the spot, in the Jurchen practice of letting the herds strip the enemy's grass land.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。金軍出戰兵力為二萬騎，由完顏阿骨打自將中軍，另有完顏迪古乃、完顏銀術可領兵屯守達魯古城。遼軍方面，《遼史》本紀記天祚帝親率大軍號稱七十萬至駝門，另遣蕭特末、蕭察剌領五萬騎與四十萬步卒屯斡鄰濼；七十萬是遼廷自報的號稱，實際集結與到陣兵力遠少於此，歷來史家多視為誇張之辭，戰場實際承受的是五萬騎與四十萬步卒這一支部。戰果方面，記載只說遼軍大潰、屍橫百餘里，蕭特末等焚營遁去，天祚帝一晝夜疾行五百里退回長春州；金軍所得輿輦、幄帳、兵械、軍資、寶物、馬牛無數，並無確切的傷亡數字。戰役之前，金軍已於一一一四年取得寧江州之戰與出河店之戰的勝利，一一一五年正月建國，同年又在達魯古城以少勝多，九月攻陷黃龍府。時間上，此役在金收國元年十二月己亥至戊申之間，農曆臘月，對應公曆一一一六年一月。地理位置上，護步答岡在今黑龍江省五常市西，斡鄰濼在今吉林省大安市南的查干泡，兩地相距約二百二十公里。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Jin field force was twenty thousand cavalry, with Aguda himself commanding the centre, and Wanyan Digu'nai and Wanyan Yinshuke holding Dalucheng. On the Liao side the Liao History records that the emperor led an army proclaimed at seven hundred thousand to Tuomen, and separately sent Xiao Temo and Xiao Chala with fifty thousand cavalry and four hundred thousand foot to hold Wolinluo. The seven hundred thousand is the figure the Liao court announced; the troops actually mustered and actually present on the field were far fewer, and historians have long treated it as an exaggeration, and what the battlefield really endured was a force of fifty thousand cavalry and four hundred thousand foot. As for the results, the record says only that the Liao army collapsed utterly, that the dead lay for more than a hundred li, that Xiao Temo and the others burned their camp and escaped, and that the emperor covered five hundred li in a day and a night back to Changchunzhou; the Jin took the imperial chariots, tents, arms, supplies, treasure, horses and cattle beyond counting, and no reliable casualty figure survives. Before the battle the Jin had already won at Ningjiangzhou and at Chuhe Dian in 1114, had founded the state in the first month of 1115, had won again at Dalucheng by superior movement, and had taken Huanglong Prefecture in the ninth month. In time the fighting fell in the twelfth lunar month of the first year of Shouguo, between the jihai and the wushen days, which corresponds to January 1116 in the Gregorian calendar. Geographically, Hupudagang lies west of Wuchang in Heilongjiang, Wolinluo lies south of Da'an in Jilin at Chagan Pao, and the two are about two hundred and twenty kilometres apart as the crow flies.
cause: 起因是女真完顏部對遼廷統治的積怨與一場失敗的談判。遼對東北女真的括戶、抽丁、徵斂與人畜擄掠，使完顏部的起兵帶有明確的控訴性質；阿骨打對族人說的那句「始與汝等起兵，蓋苦契丹殘忍，欲自立國」，是把起兵說成被逼無奈的宣言。武力上，遼軍並非沒有反擊能力，一一一四年寧江州、出河店兩戰之後，遼廷在達魯古城再敗，九月連黃龍府也失守，西部邊防門戶洞開，才被迫傾國遠征。金國建國後主動提出，只要遼國交還逃到女真方面的叛人阿疏便可停戰，但遼國回書中有「女直作過，大軍翦除」的話，談判遂告破裂；粘罕、兀術奉命出使，明為卑哀之辭，實欲求戰，阿骨打則聚集部眾仰天假哭，宣稱「非人死戰，莫能當也」，把全族推向一死。局勢還有第三層變數：耶律張家奴在十二月乙巳日反遼，渤海國後裔古欲在饒州自立為王，遼軍的西征因此始終無法按計畫執行。
causeEn: The cause lay in the accumulated grievances of the Wanyan Jurchen against Liao rule and in a negotiation that failed. Liao registration of households, the taking of men, the levies and the carrying off of people and livestock in north-eastern Jurchen territory gave the rising of the Wanyan an openly accusatory character; Aguda's words to his people, that it was because the Khitans had been cruel that they had taken up arms and meant to stand on their own feet, framed the revolt as a desperate act of self-defence. Militarily the Liao were not helpless: after the losses at Ningjiangzhou and Chuhe Dian in 1114, after another defeat at Dalucheng and the loss of Huanglong Prefecture in the ninth month, the western frontier stood wide open and the Liao court was driven to mobilise the whole realm and march far into the north. Once Jin had been founded it offered to stop the war if the Liao would hand back A-shu and the other defectors who had fled to the Jurchen, but the Liao reply spoke of cutting down the Jurchen and it would be done by the great army, and the talks broke down. Nikan and Wuzhu were sent out with humble words that were in fact a probe for the enemy's will to fight, and Aguda gathered his people, looked up to heaven and wept, declaring that unless they fought to the death nothing could stand against them, and drove the whole tribe onto the field. A third factor ran through the campaign: the revolt of Yelü Zhangjiano on the yisi day of the twelfth month, and the self-proclaimed king Guyu of the Bohai descendants at Raozhou, meant that the Liao western expedition could never be carried out as planned.
impact: 這一戰改變的不只是兩個政權的版圖，而是兩個國家的性質。遼的西征大軍在一天之內崩潰，御營的輿輦、寶物盡為女真所得，天祚帝本人倉皇逃回長春州，帝王的威信與帝國的西北邊防同時崩塌；金國則第一次證明自己不是一支流寇式的起義隊，而是一支能摧毀帝國野戰主力的國家軍隊。戰法上的示範同樣持久：以少擊多而不分兵，專攻敵之中軍再合左右，後來被兵書與軍事史家反覆引用；畫灰而議的軍中議事與伍什進位的編制，被認為是金軍戰鬥力的真正來源。戰略上，金軍由此轉入攻勢，遼的開州、特鄰城相繼失守，西部防線逐段瓦解，數年之間遼國覆亡。長期看，這場戰役是女真崛起的起點：遼亡之後金人南下，中原的靖康之變改寫了王朝的命運，東北亞的地緣格局、草原帝國的走向與歐亞大陸東端的貿易路線都隨之改變，護步達岡也自此成為中國軍事史中最常被引用的以少勝多案例。
impactEn: What this battle changed was not merely the map of two states but the nature of both. The Liao western expedition dissolved within a single day; the imperial chariots and treasure of the guard camp fell into Jurchen hands, and the emperor himself fled back to Changchunzhou in disorder, so that the authority of the throne and the north-western defence of the empire collapsed together. Jin, for its part, proved for the first time that it was not a band of insurgents but a state army capable of destroying an empire's field force. The tactical lesson was equally durable: to meet superior numbers without dividing, to strike the enemy centre and then close both wings, was cited again and again by later military writers, and the council of war in which plans were drawn in ash and the stepping system of tens and hundreds were taken to be the true source of the Jin army's fighting power. Strategically the Jin army turned to the offensive: Kai Prefecture and Telin fell in turn, the western line was broken section by section, and within a few years the Liao state was destroyed. In the longer run the battle was the beginning of the Jurchen rise; after Liao fell the Jin pushed south, the Jingkang disaster overturned the fate of the Central Plain dynasties, and the geopolitical balance of north-east Asia, the trajectory of the steppe empires and the trade routes of the far eastern end of Eurasia all changed with it. Hupudagang has been cited ever since as one of the standard cases of winning with a smaller force in an open field.
result: 遼軍主力在護步答岡崩潰，屍橫百餘里，蕭特末、蕭察剌焚營遁去，天祚帝棄輿馬而走，一晝夜疾行五百里退回長春州；遼的西征計畫就此破產。金軍繳獲輿輦、幄帳、兵械、軍資、寶物、馬牛無數，遼的西征裝備盡落女真之手；緊接著開州、特鄰城相繼失守，辭里罕等部眾歸降，遼的西部防線逐段瓦解。此役之後金軍主力轉入攻勢，遼軍節節退保，數年後遼國覆亡，天祚帝西走亦為金軍所擒。金國得到的也不只是戰場上的勝負，更是一個新國家接管舊秩序的能力：從此金國以小部族之眾行大國之軍，護步達岡也成為中國軍事史上以少勝多、決戰於野的典型案例，被後世兵家一再看重的，是那句視其中軍最堅、遼主必在焉——用全軍攻一點的辦法，擊穿數倍於己的敵陣。
resultEn: The Liao main force collapsed at Hupudagang, the dead lay for more than a hundred li, Xiao Temo and Xiao Chala burned their camp and escaped, and the emperor abandoned his chariot and horses and covered five hundred li in a day and a night back to Changchunzhou; the Liao western expedition was finished. The Jin took the imperial chariots, tents, arms, supplies, treasure, horses and cattle beyond counting, and the whole equipment of the Liao western army fell into Jurchen hands; immediately afterwards Kai Prefecture and Telin were lost in turn, Cili Khan and other tribal leaders surrendered, and the western line of the Liao was broken section by section. After this the Jin main force went on the offensive, the Liao army fell back step by step, and within a few years the Liao state was destroyed, the emperor being captured by the Jin after his flight to the west. What Jin gained was not only a victory on the field but the ability of a new state to take over an old order: from then on a small tribal people fought as a great power's army, and Hupudagang became the classic case in Chinese military history of a weaker force winning a decision fought in the open field, and the sentence the later strategists prized most was that the Liao centre was the strongest and the Liao ruler must be in it, for the whole army was thrown at a single point to break through an enemy many times its size.
